title: Friends: Joey's Bad Birthday Gift (Season 4 Clip)
summary: Joey 给女朋友 Kathy 挑的生日礼物是一支带时钟的笔，大家都说太寒碜。Chandler（其实暗恋 Kathy）只好答应替他去买礼物。开头 Chandler 想约 Kathy 看音乐剧，被她用“忙”拒绝了。

lines.en: You know what we should all do? Go see a musical.
lines.zh: 你知道我们该干嘛吗？一起去看音乐剧。

lines.en: Sure.
lines.zh: 好啊。

lines.en: You know which one we should see? The 1996 Tony Award winner.
lines.zh: 你知道该看哪部吗？1996 年托尼奖得主那部。

lines.en: Do you happen to know the name of that one?
lines.zh: 你碰巧知道它叫什么吗？

lines.en: I don't know, um, "Grease?"
lines.zh: 不知道……《油脂》？

lines.en: No. ... "Rent?" — Yes! "Rent!"
lines.zh: 不是。……《吉屋出租》？——对！《吉屋出租》！

lines.en: Okay, so when do you want to go?
lines.zh: 好，那你想什么时候去？

lines.en: What? Oh, I'm sorry. I can't, I'm busy.
lines.zh: 什么？哦，抱歉，我去不了，我很忙。

lines.en: Man, it is so hard to shop for girls.
lines.zh: 天哪，给女生买东西真难。

lines.en: Yes, it is, at Office Max!
lines.zh: 是啊，尤其是在办公用品店买！

lines.en: What did you get her? — A pen.
lines.zh: 你给她买了什么？——一支笔。

lines.en: It's two gifts in one. It's a pen that's also a clock.
lines.zh: 二合一礼物：一支也是时钟的笔。

lines.en: You can't give her that. — Why not? — Because she's not 11!
lines.zh: 你不能送这个。——为什么？——因为她又不是 11 岁！

lines.en: And it's not the seventh night of Chanukah!
lines.zh: 而且今天也不是光明节第七夜（随便凑数的小礼物）！

lines.en: Okay, honey, what he means by that is... well, this is a very nice gift, maybe it's just not something a boyfriend gives.
lines.zh: 亲爱的，他的意思是……这礼物挺好的，只是不太像男朋友送的。

lines.en: Sure it is. She needs a pen for work. She's writing, she turns it over — whoa! It's time for my date with Joey!
lines.zh: 当然像。她上班要用笔。写着写着翻过来——哇！该去跟 Joey 约会了！

lines.en: Alright, look. What did you get for Angela Del Veccio for her birthday?
lines.zh: 好吧，那你以前给 Angela 过生日送了什么？

lines.en: She didn't have a birthday while we were going out. — For three years?
lines.zh: 我们交往期间她没过生日。——三年都没过？

lines.en: Look, it's too late, and I got an audition. I can't shop anymore.
lines.zh: 来不及了，我还有试镜，没空再去买了。

lines.en: Alright, I will go out and I will try to find something for her, okay? — Thanks, man.
lines.zh: 好吧，我出去帮她找个礼物，行了吧？——谢了哥们。

lines.en: And oh, while you're at it, could you get her a card?
lines.zh: 哦对了，顺便帮她买张贺卡？

lines.en: Would you like me to write her a little poem as well? — Or just get a card that has a poem already in it.
lines.zh: 要不要我顺便给她写首小诗？——或者直接买张印好诗的卡就行。

questions.q: 开头 Chandler 绕了一大圈问音乐剧，结果怎样？
options: Kathy 说自己很忙，去不了
questions.explain: I can't, I'm busy——她委婉拒绝了。
It's a pen that's also a clock——二合一的笔。

options: 这礼物太幼稚，像送小孩的
questions.explain: 意思是：她又不是 11 岁小孩，这种礼物太孩子气。

questions.q: 最后 Chandler 答应做什么？
questions.explain: I will go out and I will try to find something for her——他去帮忙买。写诗是他的反讽。
